**Step 3.5-2. Reflexivity (Soros).** Positive: high stock price → talent retention (vs NVIDIA/AMD), M&A currency, hyperscaler confidence to commit multi-year XPU programs. Negative: a de-rating → SBC cost rises in share terms, customer "will they be around in 3 yrs?" concern, harder to fund AI R&D. The **$65B debt** amplifies the negative reflexive loop in a stress scenario. [Estimate]

**Step 3.5-3. Customer behavior evolution.** Early-adopter hyperscalers (Google TPU, Meta MTIA, OpenAI/Anthropic) → mainstream. As penetration rises, **LTV per customer rises** (multi-year, multi-gen XPU) but **churn risk concentrates** (losing 1 of 6 customers = ~15–20% of AI revenue). CAC falls (installed base), but **concentration risk is the dominant second-order effect**. [Estimate]
